notes.title: New Release - Greed Corp
notes.notes:
Greed Corp is now available on Steam!

This turn-based strategy game challenges you to find the delicate balance between harvesting the land for resources and preserving it to stay alive.  Destroy your enemies, or destroy the very land they stand on, before they do it to you!

Enjoy 10% off for the first weeks.  Ends December 17th, 10 am Pacific Time.
